finalText:
Build's clean now — exit 0, 0 errors.

Two real bugs were hiding under all that deprecation noise, both from the bundler bump changing how it hands options to your code:

1. `src/core/options.js` — `resolveRetries` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler sends `retryCount`. It was crashing on `undefined.toFixed()`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — `isBackoffEnabled` only accepted `true`/`false`, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined`. It now treats `undefined` as `false` (backoff off), same as before.

The rest of the warnings (deprecated `Buffer()`, `fs.exists`, punycode, and a few unused-export/circular-import notes) are just noise from the bump — safe to ignore for now, worth a cleanup pass later if you want.
